# acme-mcp

Older guides pinned mcp-remote@0.14.3; that version is no longer recommended.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "acme": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "mcp-remote@0.16.6", "https://mcp.example.com/sse"] }
  }
}
```

Example output from an older setup:

```text
mcp-remote@0.14.3 connected to https://mcp.example.com/sse
```
